answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so you don't need a payoff letter. We confirm the payoff with them electronically on the same day as your appointment and send the payoff the same day. The $99 home pickup fee is taken out of your payment, and you receive whatever is left after the loan is paid off. Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff; if they receive an extra payment, they refund it directly to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.
